usage: 酸 is a noun that refers to a chemical substance with sour taste commonly used in chemistry.
It is often used to describe substances that have a pH less than 7 in scientific contexts.
酸 can be combined with other words to specify different types of acids, like '硫酸' (sulfuric acid).
When describing food or flavor, 酸 refers to sourness.
In sentences, 酸 usually acts as a subject or object when talking about acids or sour taste.
